surfaces.label: DRACO mosaic
surfaces.coverage: Two DRACO frames from 158 and 94 seconds before impact. The later partial frame supplies closer detail; the earlier frame supplies wider coverage. The unseen surface keeps the grid.

limits.interpretation: Every interpolation contributor must match the full Didymos v003 mesh within 8 m and pass visibility. These acceptance limits match the retained mesh preparation budget; they do not estimate scientific accuracy.

derived.rule: A fixed contributor separation may not exceed four diagonal pixel footprints of the coarsest frame at the emission limit, plus the mesh error when the backplanes come from the archive's own shape model. A per-sample separation scales with each footprint's own range and emission. Every displayed point samples its closest source point.

photometry.formula: D=2*cos(i)/(cos(i)+cos(e)); linear radiance divided by D before interpolation; reference D(0,0)=1.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays the normalized observation; Shadows applies the existing fixed-epoch Sun bank.
photometry.limitations: No phase correction, Hapke roughness correction or cast-shadow recovery. Relative display brightness, not measured albedo.

levelMatching.interpretation: Bounded relative display-level adjustment from robust overlaps; not a phase correction or recovered albedo.

display.units: relative disk-normalized I/F; linear grayscale display

areaCoverage.method: Deterministic equal-area barycentric samples on every retained triangle; excludes atlas bleed

observation.previewPolicy: The flat preview samples unique radial intersections only; the retained triangle atlas samples the closest full-source surface point in 3D.

surfaces.label: LICIACube colour
surfaces.coverage: Eight LICIACube/LUKE frames from 165 to 179 seconds after the DART impact, through closest approach at 60 km. The camera is computed from the mission's reconstructed SPICE kernels; the three planes of each frame are the detector's red, green and blue bands, composed as a band visualization rather than a qualified natural-colour reconstruction. Every frame looks through the impact ejecta, and the kernels place the body about half a degree from where the frames show it, so coverage is partial and the registration stage reaches no verdict. The unseen surface keeps the grid.

surfaces.label: Elevation
surfaces.coverage: Released global SPC model; smooth regions have no resolved image coverage. Approximately 14 m uncertainty in x/y/z and 3.3 percent volume uncertainty; see pinned SIS and collection metadata.

surfaces.label: Relative albedo
surfaces.coverage: Sigma-positive source facets only, covering 58.2072% of the original mesh area. Sigma-zero rows mean one or no contributing images and are withheld.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
